# 3e2e95f5ad970eadfa7e17eaf73da97024aa5359

> SHA-1("potato"). A hashed potato.

## What this is

The domain label `3e2e95f5ad970eadfa7e17eaf73da97024aa5359` is the SHA-1 digest of the ASCII string `potato`.
In other words: a hashed potato.

Verification:

    $ printf potato | sha1sum
    3e2e95f5ad970eadfa7e17eaf73da97024aa5359  -

## Content

The page displays one (1) photograph of a hash brown in a paper sleeve, on a light grey background.
There is no other content.

## Why not SHA-256

SHA-256 produces 64 hexadecimal characters. A DNS label may contain at most 63.
It does not fit by one character.
